jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living  our values  and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Our engineering organization consists of many talented Android and iOS app developers distributed across the EU and US. All app developers collaborate closely on each platform, regardless of location or specific feature squad. For day-to-day feature work, our engineers are organized into smaller cross-functional feature squads or teams. Our squads have a great deal of autonomy and are responsible for the development and architecture of their features. Squads take full ownership of their code and handle everything from concepting, design and implementation to release, maintenance and bug fixes.

We are looking for Senior iOS Engineers (minimum 5 years of experience) to join one of our app development teams. There are several roles available covering different feature areas, such as activity and movement, women’s health, or new member onboarding. This is a remote US position with a preference for candidates based in the US-Pacific timezone. We have offices in San Francisco and San Diego for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. Oura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co-working locations.

What you will do:

Design, build, and maintain high quality code for projects on the team’s roadmap

Push projects forward by closely aligning with PMs and Designers

Collaborate with other teams such as backend, firmware, data science, research, science, or QA to deliver complex mobile app features

Work with iOS colleagues across the US and EU, to improve the health of the iOS codebase

Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and platform level improvements

Requirements

We would love to have you on our team if you have:

Minimum 5+ years of professional development experience shipping iOS apps

Proficiency in Swift programming, UIKit, modern iOS app architectures (MVVM, MVC, TCA, VIPER, etc.) and common third-party libraries and frameworks

Experience with collaborative development on complex shared codebases with proficiency in git, branching, and standard code review workflows

Focus on quality through unit tests and manual testing

Strong computer science fundamentals and design patterns

Ability to take ownership of projects, design technical solutions, drive implementation, and deliver results with limited guidance

jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.

About the role

The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.

As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.

We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027.

What you will do

Data pipeline

Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them

Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use

Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw machine recordings to training-ready datasets

Work with our infrastructure team to set up the chosen pipeline on Kubernetes, so that it runs reliably on our on-premise and cloud clusters

Help add data versioning, quality checks, lineage and monitoring, so that engineers can trust every dataset and trace where it came from

Collaboration and sharing

Write up the trade-offs and present your recommendation to the team

Document the pipeline and help ML and robotics engineers start using it

What we're looking for

We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field in a Swiss university

Solid Python skills and hands-on experience with data pipelines or data-heavy applications, from coursewor

jobs.description:
Your Impact

Engineering has changed, and we're changing with it. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead one or more teams into AI-native software delivery, building products used by thousands of eCommerce merchants worldwide. We're not hiring for where engineering was. We're hiring for where it's going.

You'll lead one or more engineering teams and help shape how they build software as AI reshapes the craft. You'll stay close to the work, coach your engineers, and help your teams move towards agentic workflows, with quality and security built in. We build on and around Shopify, which moves just as fast, so staying current is part of the job.

You'll work from our Leicester city centre office three days a week, with two days remote, reporting to CTO.

What you'll do

Lead, coach and grow your engineers across one or more teams, building a culture of learning and technical excellence.

Own your teams' delivery, working with Product, Design, QA and DevOps to ship high-quality work on time.

Apply the architecture team's direction, and improve the scalability and performance of your teams' systems.

Raise AI maturity across your team or teams against our maturity model, from prompt, context and harness practices towards agentic loops. Keep building with new tools yourself.

Follow our AI development standards, including review of AI-generated code, and flag tooling gaps that slow the team down.

Balance tech debt, reliability and feature delivery.

Run incident response for your teams' systems and lead post-mortems.

Take part in hiring, and support your engineers' performance and growth, including their AI fluency.

What you'll bring

5+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years leading engineering teams.

A degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience.

A track record of delivering results with a team and improving how it works.

Solid experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), microservices and API design.

Recent hands-on experience building working apps or tools with AI development tooling.

Experience with agile practices, CI/CD and incident management.

Clear communication, and the ability to link your team's work to business goals.

Nice to have:

Experience with agentic workflows

eCommerce experience, especially with Shopify

Laravel, PHP, React or AWS experience

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and mindset as much as experience - if this role excites you, we want to hear from you.

Life at clearer.io

eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on.

We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. jobs.title: CDI - AI Strategist Manager - Paris
jobs.description:
Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables
L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.

Et tout commence par vous.

Missions

En tant qu’AI Strategist Manager, vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
Who/What is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible
business impact.
With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

The role:
We are looking for a Manager who leads strategy and architecture projects focused on GenAI solutions. You will own the design of architectures and solutions end to end, balancing business value, technology choices and economics across every dimension of the decision.
You will lead development teams, present solutions to C-level stakeholders and run technical and strategic workshops independently.
Key responsibilities:
Project and programme leadership
  • Lead strategy and architecture projects on GenAI, from scoping and business case through to solution design and rollout oversight.
  • Own project plans, budgets, risks and quality, ensuring delivery against client objectives.
  • Shape proposals, estimates and demos, and identify follow-on opportunities with clients.
GenAI architecture and solution design
  • Design GenAI architectures and solutions: RAG, agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, MCP and A2A integration, copilots and assistants.
  • Select and combine cloud-native AI services (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Databricks) with third-party and custom components.
  • Apply GenAI to support functions such as HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance and IT, redesigning processes and operating models around the new solutions.
Cross-dimension optimization and trade-offs
  • Orchestrate decisions across make, buy and customization options, weighing capex against opex and total cost of ownership.
  • Assess the impact of tool and architecture choices on vendor lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Translate these trade-offs into clear recommendations that business and IT leaders can act on.
Team and stakeholder leadership
  • Guide development teams technically: set the architecture, review solutions and unblock delivery.
  • Present solutions and recommendations to C-level audiences.

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in IT.
  • At least 2 years on projects focused on AI/GenAI, Data Mesh and function

jobs.title: Marketing Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Growth at CFO Insights

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive reven

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing, Governance
jobs.description:
Hybrid role (3 days in the office, 2 days remote), based in our London office at HYLO, 103–105 Bunhill Row, London EC1Y 8LZ.

At JFrog, we’re reinventing the Software Supply Chain to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit, and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

We are looking for a visionary, strategic, and highly experienced Director of Product Marketing, Governance to join our Product Marketing leadership team. In this role, you will take full ownership of the go-to-market strategy, category creation, and global expansion for our GRC portfolio, JFrog AppTrust. By establishing JFrog as the de facto standard in "DevGovOps" and software supply chain governance, you will bridge the gap between rigid compliance requirements, security needs, and high-velocity engineering. Your deep understanding of application security, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) will translate complex regulatory frameworks into market-defining narratives. Operating as a key leader, you will accelerate enterprise adoption, pioneer a new market category, and empower organizations to make compliance a natural output of every release in an increasingly AI-driven software landscape.

As a Director of Product Marketing at JFrog you will…
  • Own the GRC Portfolio Strategy: Drive the global go-to-market strategy, positioning, and commercial success for JFrog AppTrust, operating as the definitive business leader for our governance, risk, and compliance offerings.
  • Spearhead Category Creation: Pioneer the "DevGovOps" and software supply chain governance category, building a new market from the ground up and establishing JFrog as the undisputed industry thought leader.
  • Drive Regional Success: Lead and execute targeted GTM motions to develop regional success, starting with EMEA, deeply tailoring messaging and GTM motions to regional regulatory landscapes and local compliance standards.
  • Drive Industry Credibility & Executive Engagement: Leverage your established Security and GRC network and market authority to elevate JFrog's presence in the DevSecOps and DevGovOps space. Partnering with internal subject matter experts, you will help champion the JFrog point of view and narrative across key industry organizations, conferences, strategic customer engagements, and top-tier analyst briefings.

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why HRtechX

HRtechX is a world leading HRtech community, connecting industry executives, entrepreneurs and professionals. We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. We bring together the most influential executives, investors, and entrepreneurs to share their insights on how technology will shape the future of HR, as well as forge long lasting partnerships and client relationships.

HRtechX is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys.

Your Mission

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team.

Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up.

Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Own the Outcome:  We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership.

Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change.

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Through your extraordinary communication skills, you will connect with customers to sell the value of Square to their business - quickly establishing trust and successfully building upon your relationships throughout the sales process. You're a great fit for this role if you've got an entrepreneurial spirit, a growth-oriented mindset and an innate knack for collaborative problem-solving.

jobs.title: CDI - AI Strategist Manager - Paris
jobs.description:
Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables
L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.

Et tout commence par vous.

Missions

En tant qu’AI Strategist Manager, vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Responsibilities

Aerothermal Design & Recommendations:  Provide early-stage design guidance on thermal management architecture — including cooling inlet design, heat shield placement, exhaust routing, and surface coatings — to ensure airframes remain within thermal limits across the full flight envelope.

Thermal & Aerothermal Simulation:  Set up, run, and validate lower fidelity thermal models, simulations and coupled thermal-fluid CFD tools (e.g., OpenFOAM). Model convective, conductive, and radiative heat transfer on internal components (batteries, motors, avionics) and external aerodynamic surfaces.

Design Optimization:  Drive iterative aerothermal optimization cycles to minimize thermal drag penalty, reduce hotspot intensity, and maximize cooling efficiency. Leverage scripting and automated workflows to sweep design parameters and converge on optimal configurations.

Wind Tunnel Test Campaigns:  Design, plan, and execute aerothermal wind tunnel experiments. Define instrumentation strategy (thermocouples, heat flux sensors, pressure taps), write test plans, operate test rigs, and lead post-test data analysis and correlation with simulation.

Flight Test Campaigns:  Contribute to and lead in-flight thermal measurement campaigns. Define DAQ architecture for thermal sensors, develop test matrices, analyze flight data, and correlate with CFD predictions to validate models and sign off thermal margins.

Cross-functional Integration:  Act as the thermal interface between the aerodynamics, propulsion, mechanical, and GNC teams — ensuring that thermal constraints are reflected in system-level trade-offs and that heat rejection requirements are accounted for in the airframe design.

Education:  B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring.

As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo.

For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown.

The role

As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor.

Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on.

What you'll own

Automation.

You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

Portfolio monitoring.

You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on.

Cash flow and invoicing.

You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions.

Fund accounting and reporting.

You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings.

Compliance.

You keep our funds and management company compliant, from regulatory reporting to KYC/AML checks.

Special projects.

You take on ad hoc projects across finance, from new reporting requirements to supporting FX management  .

The mission

Fast-forward - here's what you've built:

Half the manual work is gone.

Processes that used to eat your week now run on their own, because you automated them

The portfolio talks back.

AI pulls the numbers from 150+ startups, spots what's moving and puts it in front of the team before anyone asks

Portfolio reporting is an end-to-end system.

One trusted source the whole team relies on

The moonshot:

Automating the full path from term sheet to financial statements. Few funds work this way today. We want to be one of the first, and you'd be the one who helps us build it.

You'll feel at home here if you:

Learned finance where the bar is high.

Maybe in fund finance at a VC or PE firm, at a fund administrator, in Big Four audit or advisory, or in a strong controlling team

Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.

Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.

jobs.title: Architecte Backup et responsable de la Product Unit Backup - FREELANCE
jobs.description:
ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un opérateur télécom actif dans le domaine du cloud, un ou une  Architecte Backup  pour structurer et piloter sa Product Unit Backup.  Vous définissez l’architecture de sauvegarde et de restauration du cloud privé et pilotez l’équipe de moins de 10 ingénieurs DevOps chargée de la mettre en œuvre. La Product Unit s’appuie sur des solutions open source pour maîtriser les coûts, préserver l’indépendance technologique et répondre aux enjeux de souveraineté des données.  Modalités de la mission

Contrat  — Freelance

Démarrage  — Immédiat

Localisation  — Châtillon / Saint-Denis / Rennes

Télétravail  — Possible 2 jours par semaine

Durée  — 6 mois renouvelable

Vos missions

Architecture et restauration

Définir la stratégie de sauvegarde, d’archivage et de restauration des environnements Proxmox VE et Kubernetes, avec Proxmox Backup Server et Velero.

Évaluer et éprouver les solutions open source, notamment Plakar, à travers des preuves de concept.

Définir les objectifs de perte de données admissible (RPO) et de délai de reprise (RTO), ainsi que les politiques de rétention, de chiffrement et d’immutabilité.

Contribuer aux plans de continuité et de reprise d’activité (PCA/PRA) et aux tests de restauration.

Maintenir les dossiers d’architecture et d’exploitation (DAT, HLD/LLD, schémas, matrices de flux), formaliser les standards et défendre les choix techniques devant les instances de gouvernance.

Pilotage de la Product Unit

Structurer et lancer la Product Unit Backup, définir sa feuille de route, son catalogue de services et son organisation.

Prioriser les travaux, répartir la charge, suivre les déploiements et les migrations et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe DevOps.

Travailler avec les équipes produit, sécurité, réseau, stockage et cloud, ainsi qu’avec les fournisseurs et les communautés open source.

Suivre le taux de succès des sauvegardes, la conformité et les temps de restauration. Contribuer à l’automatisation et à la veille sur la cyber-résilience.

Profil recherché

8 à 10 ans d’expérience en infrastructures, dont au moins 3 ans comme architecte ou référent technique, avec une expérience confirmée du pilotage d’équipe ou de projets.

Maîtrise indispensable de Proxmox VE et de Proxmox Backup Server.

Expérience de Kubernetes et de Velero. Connaissance de Plakar ou forte appétence pour cet outil.

Maîtrise des architectures de sauvegarde (3-2-1, immutabilité, air gap, déduplication, chiffrement). Pratique de Linux, du cloud privé et du stockage objet compatible S3.

Connaissances DevOps (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps) et pratique de l’automatisation (Ansible, Terraform, Bash ou Python).

Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, leadership, pédagogie et capacité à défendre des choix techniques.

La connaissance de VMware ou KVM, les contributions open source et l’anglais technique sont appréciés.  Pour postuler

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand:  Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.

Know the Why:  We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.

Innovate & Iterate:  We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome:  We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a demonstrated ability to lead and grow distributed teams of strong engineers working remotely around the world. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership.

Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change.

jobs.title: Senior Structures Analysis Engineer, Launch Vehicle Structure (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mission Brief

You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward.

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

  • Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures
  • Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs.
  • Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc.
  • Analise and provide possible solutions to manufacturing non-conformities
  • Develop test plans and support physical testing of components to verify sizing assumptions and qualify hardware.
  • Prepare comprehensive stress analysis reports and documentation for internal/external use
  • Improve our standards and toolchain for structural verification
  • Be familiar with classical design standards and have experience in the use of CAD software
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior eng

jobs.title: Principal System Architect, Spectrum (m/f/d)
jobs.description:

As Principal System Architect for Reusability, you will lead exploration of the reusable-launcher design space and drive convergence towards a coherent vehicle architecture.   • Balance vehicle performance and recovery with production, supply chain, logistics, launch operations, refurbishment, cadence, lifecycle cost, market demand and profitability.

Qualification Checklist

  • Extensive launch-vehicle architecture experience, including direct work on rocket development programs.

jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description:
WHY this position is important  Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it.  The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is  Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible.  These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.

HOW you will contribute  You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor.  Every topic follows the same path:

Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter.

A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3.

Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result.

You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results.

Topics for 2027  Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you.

Reading invoices and new types of documents  with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

Knowing when the AI is right : calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions.

Evaluating accounting agents : an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring.

Learning from accountants' corrections : turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees.

Bank reconciliation : matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation.

An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets : from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production.

Data foundations for AI : evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own.

AI will be part of how you work  You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Pyth

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

jobs.description:
Account Executive, Payments (Existing Merchants)

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might be in the right place!

We are looking for an Account Executive, Payments, who  is responsible for driving the adoption of Lightspeed Payments within Lightspeed's existing merchant base in the Netherlands. This is a dedicated cross-sell/upsell position focused on transitioning current Point of Sale (POS) customers to our proprietary, integrated payment processing solution.  Lightspeed Payments has been continually invested into since launch in 2019, integrating a number of unique value drivers into the combined POS-payments solution.  Building off of success our new business teams have experienced in selling the combined POS-payments solution, we are scaling our ability to sell payments into our existing merchant base, many of which became clients before we scaled Lightspeed Payments.

This position reports to the Global Payments Sales Manager and is part of the Global Payments GTM team.

Your Mission

The primary responsibility is to meet and exceed sales targets for Lightspeed Payments adoption among existing merchants.

Pipeline Management:  Generate and manage sales opportunities using leads sourced from Account Managers, direct phone/email outreach, and follow-up on company-led marketing campaigns.

Sales Execution:  Manage the complete sales cycle from initial qualification and value presentation through pricing negotiation and contract closure.

Customer Launch:  Partner with Onboarding teams to ensure a smooth transition and launch for merchants adopting Lightspeed Payments.

Internal Expertise:  Serve as the internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) on payment processing for other units, providing guidance and training as required.

Product Feedback:  Collect and relay merchant feedback regarding the payments product to the Product Management teams.

Reporting:  Maintain accurate records of all sales activities, pipeline status, and opportunity notes in Salesforce

Other Duties:  Handle additional duties and responsibilities as defined by management.

What you’ll be bringing to the team

Payments Experience:  Direct experience (3+ years) in the payment processing industry.

Sales Closing Role:  Demonstrated experience (3+ years) in a closing role focused on technology or solution sales.

Opportunity Development:  Proven ability to proactively generate and qualify new opportunities.

Target Achievement:  Documented history of success in a revenue target or quota-based environment.

Communication:  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch language skills are a requirement.

What’s in it for you?

Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing  as you are

An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

Unser Team

Medical Science ist der medizinische Kern von BetterDoc. Wir übersetzen medizinisches Wissen in Produkte: strukturierte Daten, Entscheidungslogik und zunehmend KI. Ärztinnen und Ärzte bauen bei uns selbst Prototypen und bringen sie gemeinsam mit Product und Engineering live. Als Werkstudent arbeitest du direkt in diesem Team mit.

Zur Verstärkung suchen wir ab sofort einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) am Standort Köln oder remote.

Im Tagesgeschäft

Medizinische Datenbank pflegen: Du hältst unsere medizinische Datenbank aktuell. Du recherchierst gezielt, bereitest Daten strukturiert auf und validierst sie systematisch.

Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du hilfst dabei, Arbeitsprozesse und Konzepte rund um unsere Datenbank weiterzuentwickeln und zu automatisieren.

KI und Prototypen

Prompts und Prototypen mitentwickeln: Du schreibst und testest Prompts und baust gemeinsam mit dem Team kleine Werkzeuge, zum Beispiel mit Claude, Python, SQL oder Google Apps Script.

KI-Ergebnisse medizinisch prüfen: Du bewertest Ergebnisse unserer KI-Anwendungen fachlich, baust Test- und Referenzdatensätze mit auf und findest Fehler, bevor sie bei Patienten ankommen.

Medizinisches Wissen strukturieren: Du überführst medizinische Informationen in strukturierte Daten und Klassifikationen wie ICD, OPS und SNOMED CT.

Mit dem Produktteam zusammenarbeiten: Du bringst deine medizinische Perspektive in die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Systeme mit Product und Engineering ein und siehst, wie ein Prototyp zum Produkt wird.

Du studierst Humanmedizin und bist an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, idealerweise im klinischen Studienabschnitt.

Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und genau

jobs.title: End-of-Line Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure?  You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems?

Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone.

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Tasks

Your mission

We are looking for an exceptional End-of-Line Robotics Engineer to take ownership of the automated stations that check every produced drone before it flies.

These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will be at the heart of our quality control: understand how a drone can fail, find the best way to detect it, and turn that into a reliable validation test on the production line.

You will work closely with our R&D  and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time.

Core responsibilities

Explore different ways to detect each drone defect, choose what to measure and set pass/fail criteria based on data.

Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number.

Program handling routines for our collaborative robot and integrate them safely with fixtures and sensors.

Move proven tests into the Calibration & Validation room, make them robust for daily use by operators, and improve cycle time, coverage and uptime as volumes grow.

Analyse results across the fleet, spot trends and drifts, and report defects to design and production so they are fixed at the source.

Requirements

Your profile

You combine strong engineering and analytical skills with solid software craft. You break complex problems down, reason from data rather than assumptions, and enjoy getting a station working hands-on, not only in code.

At least 2 years in test engineering, validation, test automation or production test, ideally on robotic or electromechanical products.

Solid robotics fundamentals: modelling system dynamics, choosing sensors and actuators: understanding their trade-offs (noise, bias, bandwidth, cost).

Comfortable with reference frames and transforms: relating to IMU, camera and robot or vehicle frames, and how their data is fused together.

General knowledge of state estimation and control theory (e.g. Kalman filtering, PID and feedback loops)

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong.   • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.

You will own the core ML platform for a new capability at Roblox: a safety user feature store, user embeddings, and risk scores that power personalized consequences, proactive detection, and early education.   • Own Data Quality and Governance: Build monitoring for feature freshness, drift, lineage, and ownership, so teams across Safety can trust and reuse signals.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

jobs.title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

What you'll do:

Risk Management

  • Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests
  • Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented
  • Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress
  • Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting
  • Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation

Compliance and Audit

jobs.title: HBO/BACHELOR HRM STAGE
jobs.description:
Bufab Flos is op zoek naar een enthousiaste en leergierige HR-stagiair(e) die ons team komt versterken. Tijdens je stage krijg je de mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen diverse HR-werkzaamheden, jezelf te ontwikkelen én actief mee te draaien binnen de organisatie.

Wie zijn wij? 
Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. Wij zijn specialist in het leveren van bevestigingsmaterialen, technische componenten en logistieke diensten. Dat doen we niet zomaar: wij denken actief mee met onze klanten en adviseren bij technische vraagstukken. Of het nu gaat om A‑merk bevestigingsmaterialen, staal, RVS, gestandaardiseerde onderdelen, assemblages of maatwerk volgens klantspecificatie — wij regelen het volledig. Van sourcing en inkoop tot kwaliteitsbewaking, opslag en levering. In alles wat we doen staat één doel centraal: onze klanten maximaal ontzorgen door meerwaarde te bieden op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit en logistiek. Ons uitgangspunt is daarbij helder: afspraak is afspraak.

Met 140 betrokken collega’s vormen we een divers en internationaal team. Bufab Flos maakt onderdeel uit van het Zweedse Bufab, maar is tegelijkertijd een toegankelijke organisatie waar samenwerken centraal staat. Onze medewerkers maken het verschil – en HR speelt hierin een belangrijke rol.

Om onze HR-afdeling te versterken én jou de kans te geven om ervaring op te doen, bieden wij een leerzame en veelzijdige meewerkstage op HBO/Bachelor-niveau aan.

Wat ga je doen?

Als HR-stagiair(e) draai je volledig mee binnen het HR-team en krijg een brede kijk op het HR-vak. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:  🔍 Ondersteunen bij werving- en selectie  🚀 Ondersteunen bij onboarding en offboarding  🗂️ Up-to-date houden van onze HR-systemen  🤝 Ondersteuning bij verzuimbegeleiding  💡 Meewerken aan HR-projecten zoals duurzame inzetbaarheid, talentmanagement, medewerkertevredenheid, learning & development  🎓 Ruimte voor een praktijkgerichte opdracht of onderzoek in overleg met je opleiding

Wat zoeken wij in jou?

Jij bent iemand die energie krijgt van HR en zin heeft om zichzelf verder te ontwikkelen.
Je herkent jezelf hierin:

Je volgt een HBO/Bachelor-opleiding in de richting HRM en zit minimaal in je derde leerjaar

Je bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027

Je bent proactief en leergierig

Je werkt nauwkeurig en gaat vertrouwelijk om met informatie

Je vindt het leuk om te werken met mensen én HR-systemen

Je bent zelfstandig, zoekt graag zelf dingen uit maar durft ook om hulp te vragen

Je werkt graag samen, denkt in oplossingen en hebt een groeimindset

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Bufab Flos krijg je geen standaard stage, maar een plek waar je écht kunt leren en groeien. Dit kun je van ons verwachten:

Een veelzijdige meewerkstage waarin je het HR-vak in de praktijk leert

As a Senior Process and Equipment Engineer - PVD, you will take ownership of advanced PVD and CVD deposition processes and equipment within FabONE. Optimize film properties, including refractive index, stoichiometry, stress, thickness and thickness uniformity

Reduce inline defect density and improve process repeatability, stability and yield

Use Design of Experiments, SPC and root-cause analysis to improve process and equipment performance

Establish SPC baselines and routine monitoring protocols for deposition processes and equipment

Troubleshoot vacuum, RF power, matching-network, magnetron-sputtering and gas-delivery systems

Develop preventive-maintenance and operation procedures and coordinate technical support with equipment vendors

Train shift engineers and technicians on daily PVD tool operation, monitoring and troubleshooting

What You Bring

Extensive hands-on experience in PVD process and equipment engineering, including sputtering or impulse-deposition technologies

Strong experience developing, optimizing and releasing semiconductor deposition processes in a cleanroom fab environment

Expertise in controlling thin-film properties such as refractive index, stoichiometry, thickness uniformity, film stress and defect density

Experience with Si and SiN thin-film deposition and dielectric-layer optimization

A proven track record of installing, commissioning, accepting and qualifying new process tools or chambers

Strong hardware troubleshooting skills across vacuum systems, RF generators, matching networks, magnetron sputtering and gas-delivery subsystems

Experience using thin-film characterization techniques such as ellipsometry, XRF or comparable measurement systems

Proficiency in Statistical Process Control and Design of Experiments, including tools such as JMP or Minitab

Experience establishing preventive-maintenance routines and improving equipment uptime

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. Proven experience in software testing and test automation, ideally with experience building or significantly improving QA processes and testing frameworks from the ground up.

Proficiency with at least one end-to-end testing framework, with Playwright or Cypress strongly preferred, as well as experience with API testing using Postman/Newman, VI Test, or equivalent tools.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.  At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting.  In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.  And we build at scale. More than  600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries  rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than  $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.  If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters,  this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What You Will Do

Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform.

Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams.

Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build.

jobs.description:
This is Cradle  Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.  We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.  We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

jobs.description:

It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.  We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

About the Team  Our growth starts with reaching the right sellers and earning their trust. You'll join Growth & Marketing alongside Creative, CRM and Brand, and work in an acquisition squad with teammates from Product, Tech and Operations. A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead.

The Role  As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings.

Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll also help us use AI to manage campaigns, produce ads and analyze performance, so the team can manage more spend and run more tests with the same headcount.

Allocate €15M+ a year by cost per booked meeting.  Compare costs across segments and recognise when fewer leads signal better performance.

Measure what your campaigns actually add.  Design and interpret geo-lift or holdout tests to find out how many extra meetings a campaign generated, and use the results to move budget.

Run acquisition with AI.  Build your own agents and automations for campaign management, ad production and performance analysis, then measure their impact.

Use campaign results to improve creative.  Brief and challenge our agency and freelancers, then work with our Content Strategist to turn what you learn into the next round of tests.

What You'll Do  Set the paid acquisition strategy

Set quarterly targets with our Growth & Marketing Lead based on how sellers behave, how the market is changing and what competitors are doing.

Decide how to split spend across channels and campaigns to hit those targets and keep generating leads at a sustainable cost beyond the quarter.

Find and launch new paid channels and lead-generation partnerships.

Own daily performance and the €15M+ budget

Optimise campaigns daily with Sales, Brand and Product

jobs.title: AI Product Builder - BeReal
jobs.description:
About Voodoo  Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta.  Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

About BeReal  At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role  We're hiring a new kind of product talent: one person who owns the full product loop, from user insight to shipped features to measured impact, using AI to build. You'll own a product area and a key metric, with senior engineers shipping your prototypes.

Talk to users and dig into the data to find what to build next.

Set the strategy: hypotheses, priorities, what to build or kill.

Build and ship features yourself with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…).

Instrument your features, build data dashboards and run A/B tests.

Own the results and iterate fast.

Profile

You're a builder: a technical PM who ships with AI, a product engineer with strong product sense, or a former founder.

You have a sharp product intuition for consumer apps (social is a plus).

You're hyper analytical: funnels, cohorts, experimentation.

You ship working software with AI and understand tech well enough to work with senior engineers.

You're fast, autonomous and take full ownership.

You're fluent in English (French is a plus).

Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience

Swile Lunch voucher

Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

Wellness activities in our Paris office

Remote days on Fridays

jobs.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait .

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.  Alan exists to end the wait.  Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.  So we are building the  new standard in prevention insurance.  Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.  We are on an incredible journey to build a  global leading company, with a

unique culture

. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.  Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.  Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).  You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.  At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the  Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).  We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

jobs.title: Médecin Généraliste - Chat médical 🇫🇷
jobs.description:
🐻 Qui est Alan ?

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant  assurance santé  et  clinique virtuelle  dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai  partenaire santé .  La  Clinique Alan  réunit plus de  120 professionnels de santé  disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.  Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :

🩺  Téléconsultation vidéo  : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

💬  Chat médical  : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

🤖  Mo, notre compagnon santé IA  : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins

🎯  Des programmes de prévention  (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

🧘  Alan Play  : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes à l'aise avec la médecine à distance et motivé(e)s à rejoindre notre service de chat médical - pour  accompagner nos membres avec des conseils médicaux de qualité , mais aussi pour  contribuer à la revue médicale de notre compagnon de santé.

✅ Enthousisate à l’idée d’intégrer l’IA dans sa pratique.

✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)
