About  ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I’m

Colin  , Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been  skunkworks  projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a  pessimistic  mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is  optimistic  about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an

experienced, talented, and collaborative team

jobs.description:
Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer,

your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time.

360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue.

We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for.

“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach.

Within 1 month, you will:

Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture

Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer

Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily

Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end

Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end

Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production

Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up

Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts

Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention

Within 12 months, you will:

Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks

Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope

Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op.

DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS.

Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code.

CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk.

Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken.

Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions.  Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés.  Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates).  Développer un moteur de validation automatique permettant de contrôler l'intégrité et la cohérence des projets après migration. Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant  génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation , avec des applications concrètes dans le domaine ferroviaire.

Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs ou en Master 2 Informatique / Génie logiciel, préparant un diplôme de niveau Bac+5.

Utilisation des outils de gestion de versions (Git/SVN).  Connaissances en tests unitaires et qualité logicielle.

jobs.title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
jobs.description:
Over Noldus

Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers  wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen  worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot  ziekenhuizen en bedrijven.

We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons  beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige  stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en  aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen.

De stageopdracht

Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en  overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers?

Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe  videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team  bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste  kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je  zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:  • Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke

mogelijkheden ze bieden.  • Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je

functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien.  • Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke

waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek.  • Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of

functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen.  • Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om

bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot  eindproduct.  • Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de

grootste kansen liggen.  • Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning.  • Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in

gebruik.  • Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt.  • Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe

huisstijl.  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en

andere digitale kanalen.

Wat willen we bereiken?

Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent  die:  • Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert.  • Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden

gebruikt.  • Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.  Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.  Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.  Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.  At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:
 We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and scale the operational engine behind DeepJudge’s marketing and qualified pipeline growth.  This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign and attribution systems. You’ll act as a strategic and operational business partner to Content, Field, Demand Gen and Product Marketing, and work with Sales, RevOps and Partnerships to make sure every lead and target account reaches the right seller, and that we know which programs created the pipeline.  If you naturally think: “Which campaign actually created this opportunity, and why did it take three days to reach a rep?” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. You will play a key role in giving our growing sales team a reliable flow of qualified pipeline and in driving commercial success.

Your responsibilities will include:

Lead and account lifecycle

Own the  lead and account lifecycle  from first touch to sales-qualified opportunity, including lifecycle stages, MQL/SQL definitions and SLAs

Design and maintain  lead scoring, inbound routing  and assignment rules as the marketing and sales team grows

Run the  Marketing-to-Sales handoff  with clear acceptance criteria and feedback loops

Campaign, event and partner marketing operations

Administer  HubSpot Marketing Hub  and its integrations with ad, event and enrichment tools

Operationalize  field and growth marketing : event lead capture, ABM programs, nurture workflows and partner campaigns

Own  campaign attribution  and pipeline source

Our customers are some of the world’s largest asset operators and industrial companies. Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day.  Customer.io  powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?  We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role  Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.

Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps.

This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.

What You'll Build & Own

On-device Android software:  Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.

Fleet-ready releases:  Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.

Hardware & firmware integration:  Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.

Mobile contribution:  Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.

AI-native development:  Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.

Solid Android engineering experience: A min

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Accounting
jobs.description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity - Senior Manager, Accounting - (Remote - USA / CANADA)

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Accounting who combines technical accounting expertise with a drive to build better systems, processes, and teams.

If you want to maintain existing processes, this isn’t the role for you. If you want to be accountable for the numbers, build the tooling that makes them faster and more reliable, and develop a team that does the same, it is.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Controller, you’ll own the monthly close, the financial statements, and the general ledger for a complex, multi-product fintech platform. You’ll own the quality of our financial statements and help shape the systems that produce them, with direct partnership across Engineering, Product, and Operations, as well as use AI in your own work to improve accuracy and efficiency.

We’re advancing an AI-driven transformation of our accounting function. With Rillet as our ERP and elements of the close already automated, you’ll have a strong platform to build on. The foundation however remains essential: accurate numbers, reconciliations and sound controls. From there, you’ll use technology to automate manual work, improve accuracy, and support growth. You should think in systems, challenge processes that rely on manual or repetitive effort, and recognize when a recurring reconciliation/task could become a controlled, automated workflow.

You’ll bring the technical accounting expertise and sound judgment to prepare us for our first financial statement audit and support our next stage of growth. You’ll translate complex transactions and new products into clear accounting policies, well-supported conclusions, and reliable financial reporting. By strengthening documentation, controls, and review practices, you’ll build an accounting foundation that meets audit expectations and scales with the business.

What you’ll do:

Own the financial statements from close to delivery. Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and review the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement for accuracy and GAAP compliance.

Own the post-implementation build-out of Rillet (ERP) to a fully functional ERP. Build the rules and controls that drive how transactions post. Connect Rillet to our subledger and source systems so data flows in without manual entry; building a close that runs on  automation .

Redesign the ledger and chart of accounts for how the business operates

Senior Product Manager II, Fraud & Identity (Remote – USA / CANADA)

Do you get energized by thinking like a bad actor so you can build the products that catch them? Is turning good analysis into a shipped, prioritized roadmap the thing you're proudest of, more than the analysis itself? Then this is the role for you.

You'll define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for how we detect, prevent, and respond to fraud, and how we verify and protect identity, across the full customer lifecycle. Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for fraud and identity/authentication across the customer lifecycle — from prevention to detection to response.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark based in Netherlands.

We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, reliable data integration solutions in a fully remote European environment.
You will build and optimise modern ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
Working extensively with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake, you will contribute to robust, high-performing data platforms.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.

jobs.title: Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean based in Netherlands.

As an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts, you will bridge the worlds of architecture, customer relationship management, and software development. You will showcase innovative building configurators to international customers, demonstrating how complex project requirements can be transformed into permit-ready building designs within minutes. Combining architectural expertise with technical understanding, you will adapt product demonstrations to different customer needs and evaluate new features from a practical planning perspective. You will also manage relationships with strategic accounts, understand their workflows, and translate operational challenges into actionable product requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, and software developers, you will help improve product quality and ensure successful customer adoption. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to influence the future of digital building planning within an international, collaborative team.

Accountabilities:

You will combine product demonstrations, architectural quality assurance, and strategic account management to ensure that customers successfully adopt building configurators while providing valuable insights to improve the product.

Customer Demonstrations: Prepare and deliver engaging product demonstrations for customers and partners, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site, in English, German, or Korean.

Tailored Product Presentations: Adapt demonstrations to specific customer use cases, building types, and project requirements while explaining design logic, planning regulations, and generated outputs.

Architectural Quality Assurance: Test new features and configurators before release, evaluating generated site layouts, floor plans, and building models for architectural plausibility, buildability, and compliance with underlying rules.

Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities, documenting findings with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and structured feedback.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with planning and algorithm teams to prioritize issues and ensure product improvements reflect real architectural and customer requirements.

Product Feedback & Roadmap: Gather insights from customer demonstrations and conversations, translating feedback into actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.

Knowledge Management: Develop reusable demonstration scripts, test cases, and shared documentation to improve internal knowledge sharing and product evaluation processes.

Key Account Management: Serve as the primary product-side contact for selected strategic customers, building strong relationships with their expansion, planning, and real estate

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting Manager based in Switzerland.

As Accounting Manager, you will oversee accounting operations and lead financial integration across a growing international group of software businesses. Handle intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and reporting adjustments.

Statutory Audit Management: Act as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating and managing statutory audits, particularly across European and Canadian entities.

Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and develop the GL team, establish clear priorities, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Wild Rift
jobs.description:
Riot Games is looking for a Systems Engineer to join the Game Operations team supporting Wild Rift. You will help operate and improve the infrastructure, services, and tools that support reliable live-service operations for the game.

This is a hands-on role focused on automation, production support, incident response, observability, data integrity, and continuous improvement. You will work with engineering, platform, data, and operations teams to reduce risk, improve efficiency, and protect player experience. Internal Job Title: Systems Engineer II.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate and improve the production infrastructure, cloud services, data platforms, and operational systems that support Wild Rift.
  • Build automation and tooling for deployments, migrations, validation, capacity management, and routine operations.
  • Troubleshoot distributed systems and participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements.
  • Support releases and operational changes while maintaining service continuity and data integrity.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and other operational documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, capacity, and infrastructure cost.
  • Collaborate with global technical partners and provide day-to-day support and guidance to operations teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience, RHCE, RHCSA.
  • 2+ years of industry experience or an advanced degree.
  • Professional experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting production services, preferably in a high-availability or live-service environment.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, storage, compute, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with AWS Cloud and/or Tencent Cloud.
  • Ability to write maintainable automation or production code in Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and data-platform concepts, including data movement, replication, validation, and operational integrity.
  • Familiarity with Git-based configuration management, infrastructure as code, or deployment automation.
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.
  • Professional fluency in Mandarin and English, with the ability to work across time zones and technical disciplines.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with distributed data technologies, object storage, Kubernetes, Redis, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-volume online services, game telemetry, or player data.

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our  Institutional Page

Audit Senior Specialist

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.  Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.  Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one.  This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.  You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees.

jobs.description:

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

  • Lead the design, analysis, integration, and testing of assigned electrical systems for our hybrid-electric aircraft. jobs.title: Incident Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

Community Trust is at the core of our efforts to keep Twitch a welcoming and safe place for people to build safe and inclusive communities that enable diverse, global creators to flourish.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Risk Assessment, you will work on the Risk & Strategic Response team, responding to emergent risks to our community safeguards, avoid potential risks, and guide implementation of solutions in areas such as operations, products, and policy. You will coordinate with partners across Community Trust, Product, Partnerships, Communications, and Legal to lead the response and review of safety incidents. Additionally, you will work asynchronously with teams across the globe to ensure delivery of corrective actions.

We look for the individuals who have a bias for action, keep a cool head in a crisis, and can operate autonomously and independently. We are looking for someone with a background in areas such as Trust & Safety, incident response, risk management, project management, or safety by design.

You can work in San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA or Seattle, WA.

You Will:

  • Respond to incidents escalated from across the business, such as severe or trending harms to the community or breakdowns in our community safeguards
  • Coordinate across multiple geographic teams, including Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Fraud, Policy, Product, Engineering, Legal, Communications, and others to handle incident response and communication
  • Work well during high

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is one of its first engineering hires. The Enterprise Platform team is brand new. You will not be inheriting a mature system or a long backlog: you will own core domains of the platform that turns the internal systems enabling Discordians into self-service software.

Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels. As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Security Risk team is responsible for how Anthropic identifies, prioritizes, and drives treatment of its most important security risks. We are rebuilding risk management to operate as an engineering function through automation and AI-native platforms to enable decision making. The systems we assess span Anthropic’s full security landscape, from authorization primitives to cryptographic foundations, so the team needs breadth across domains and the ability to go deep in any of them. Security Risk, in deep partnership with Security Engineering, will help define the security program to shape how both engineers and non-engineers build and ship software.

The conventional GRC playbook was not built for a company shipping frontier AI. You will help define what replaces it, with a direct line to CISO-level decisions and the mandate to build the AI-native platform underneath. You’ll work across a breadth of areas from identity and secrets management to infrastructure security, with your focus shaped by your strengths, ability to learn quickly, and the team’s priorities. This is largely greenfield work, and you will help define the architecture and discipline.

  • Take ownership of Anthropic’s most complex security risk problems and drive them end to end with minimal oversight, turning ambiguous signals into a defensible view of severity and likelihood and seeing them through escalation, treatment decisions, and remediation
  • Build the systems that make risk measurable and let risk work scale, including quantification tooling, automated intake and triage, and the observability that partner teams use to understand their own risk posture
  • Work alongside Security Engineering as a calibrated technical peer who pressure tests architectures and treatment plans, translates findings into prioritized remediation roadmaps, and makes the investment case for what to fix now, what to accept and track, and what to defer

The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.

You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together.

Our current data platform includes:

Ingestion: Stitch

jobs.title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
jobs.description:
Freelance Assignment
4 January to 30 April 2027 
5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays)
Reporting to COO

The Challenge  Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation.  Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through.  We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs  our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch.

What You'll Do

Keep things running

Keep ops moving:  Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks.

Run verification:  Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips.

Go deep on payments

Get up to speed:  Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most.

Fix it weekly:  Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers.

Create order:  By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute.

What You'll Bring

Must have

5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side.

Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes.

Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

We’re looking for someone who is highly creative, quick-witted, and excited to experiment. You should be overflowing with social and short-form video ideas, comfortable moving quickly from concept to execution, and confident identifying cultural moments that Pokémon GO can authentically join.This is also a hands-on, on-camera role. The ideal candidate is energized by interacting with players, not simply responsible for it. You’ll engage directly with the Pokémon GO community, develop content that speaks to regional and global audiences, and translate trends into ideas that feel unmistakably Pokémon GO.

If you’re a short-form video expert who can generate a steady stream of executable ideas and bring those ideas to life quickly—we want to hear from you.

  • Support the day-to-day planning and execution of content across Pokémon GO’s official social media channels, including copywriting, publishing, community engagement, performance tracking, and contributing to an energetic, authentic brand voice
  • Generate a consistent pipeline of creative, timely, and executable social content ideas, with a strong emphasis on short-form video. Identify promising video formats, trends, hooks, and cultural moments, then translate them into content that feels authentic to Pokémon GO and its community

  • Develop campaign, content, and video briefs that clearly communicate creative direction, messaging, format, and cultural relevance
  • Monitor trends and emerging digital behaviors, particularly those influencing Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences
  • Lead player engagement across official Pokémon GO social channels, building meaningful connections with players and contributing an energetic, authentic brand voice.

jobs.title: Senior Graphics Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Fortnite Desktop team is seeking an experienced Senior Rendering Engineer to enhance the player experience on PC. You will work with other engineers and directly contribute to building and improving our Desktop platform support to an industry-leading state.

This role is the perfect opportunity to work on the rendering systems that power Fortnite's visuals. You will improve existing features and systems and design new ones to ensure the best player experience across a wide variety of hardware and software configurations.

In this role, you will

  • Analyze and resolve stability and performance problems of Fortnite on a wide range of PC hardware configurations; this includes identifying solutions in such areas as:
    • Solving device-specific CPU and GPU performance and compatibility issues
    • Rendering performance and device compatibility, including the shader pipeline
    • Improving rendering systems and optimizing their stability and performance across various graphics APIs
    • Improvements in low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e., memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, and input systems
  • Monitor stability and performance data from Fortnite releases and improve Unreal Engine’s systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Work with GPU vendors and other partners to resolve technical issues and collaborate on improving underlying technologies, such as graphics drivers for Fortnite and Unreal Engine
  • Assess performance data across various hardware and improve Unreal Engine’s rendering systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Collaborate with a variety of other Epic teams, such as Unreal Engine’s Rendering Architecture team, to help them solve complex technical challenges in ways that move the stability and quality of Fortnite and our internal products forward

What we're looking for

  • Strong C++ knowledge and multi-thread

Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.  Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.  You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.  This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting.  In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.  And we build at scale. More than  600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries  rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than  $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.  If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters,  this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

jobs.title: Digital CS Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our  public roadmap  to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations.

What you'll do

Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work.

Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps.

Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t.

Write and maintain the customer communication for your plays across email, in-app and agent instructions, in language that fits our brand.

Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s.

Work with the onboarding

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Mid-Office | Python
jobs.description:
BlockTech is hiring a Software Engineer to join its Mid-Office team in Amsterdam.  Positions, PnL, and hedging all run through Mid-Office. When a number our traders or risk team rely on is wrong, this is where it gets found and fixed.  In this role, you'll build and run that platform, and you'll be the one who follows a wrong number until you know why.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.  The Mid-Office team owns the systems that keep positions, PnL, and hedging correct across every venue we trade. We work in Python, with Grafana and PostgreSQL alongside.

What will you do?

You will build and own the systems that keep our books and data accurate, including the quantitative work behind them. You'll be responsible for spotting discrepancies, investigating unexpected numbers, and tracing issues to their root cause.  You will:

Own the books. Maintain and evolve our position, trade, and PnL systems so they stay accurate across every venue.

Do the quant work. Build and refine our hedging, Greeks, margin models, and early exercise premium calculations.

Surface the risk. Build the risk views and calculations that show traders and the risk team what exposure we're carrying.

Support the desk. Work side by side with traders and researchers, and make sure the data they rely on is correct and available.

Deliver reporting. Provide the data internal stakeholders and regulators need: PnL breakdowns, trade surveillance, treasury accounting, and compliance.

Own it in production. Spot discrepancies in live data, trace the root cause, and maintain what you ship.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

You'll need to be an engineer at heart, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine passion for building and improving systems.

A relevant educational background, ideally in a quantitative field such as mathematics, econometrics, or computer science.

Professional experience with Python, Grafana, and PostgreSQL.

Strong debugging skills. You can trace problems to their source, even in unfamiliar systems.

A critical mind that follows problems through to completion, high ownership, and clear communication in English.

Bonus points for:

Experience in finance, ideally trading, on the systems behind positions, PnL, risk, and hedging.

Pay, location, and relocation

Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% tax ruling.

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. Your work may span product research and experimentation, AI evaluation, and applied data tools and capabilities. You’ll collaborate with partners in Data Science, Engineering, Product, Design, and AI Research, working closely with product teams and across the broader organization.   • Design measurement approaches for products and AI-powered experiences, using methods such as experiments, causal inference, and evaluation frameworks to understand quality, behavior, and customer value
  • Use code to investigate hypotheses and develop analyses, models, prototypes, or research tools, choosing approaches that fit the question and make results reproducible

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

jobs.title: Director of User Experience (UX) Research
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.

You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.
  • Uncover opportunities and build a shared understanding of our users. Lead foundational and generative research that surfaces unmet needs, pain points, and emerging behaviors, and use segmentation, longitudinal, and international research to understand how different user cohorts use Discord and where their needs differ, so teams design for real people instead of assumptions.
  • Own usability and concept validation. Establish a consistent program for testing concepts, prototypes, and live experiences, so teams learn early whether ideas are desirable, usable, and valuable before investing heavily.
  • Bring a mixed-methods lens to every major decision. Partner with Data Science to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence (surveys, behavioral data, experimentation) that explains both what users do and why. Define and track experience-health measures such as satisfaction, ease, and trust over time.

jobs.title: Senior Research Programmer, Epic Developer Assistant
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Research Programmer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

  • Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting
  • Design and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine
  • Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling
  • Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation
  • Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend programmers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

  • Strong programming background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting
  • Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context programming), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work
  • Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment
  • Excellent programming skills across C++ (engine-side) and Python and/or a web backend language
  • Experience in the games industry or equivalent, developing interactive entertainment products
  • Ability to work full-stack and reason about tradeoffs across engine code, backend services

jobs.description:

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

Cinematic Director, Fortnite Ecosystem – Cinematic Trailers

What We Do

In the Cinematics Team, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible in realtime. We are in the early stages of this growth in realtime quality work and we are growing quickly and implementing various techniques and ideas to improve what can be done in Unreal Engine. Our team is one of the few at the forefront of delivering innovation, through cinematic quality visuals.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a collaborative Cinematic Director to join our Fortnite cinematics team who can help craft high-impact trailers and short-form content that connects with the Fortnite audience.

We're looking for a hands-on filmmaker who uses Unreal Engine as a creative tool and is excited to jump into Sequencer to explore, iterate, and build.

Tone matters as much as craft. Strong comedic instincts and a feel for playful, irreverent, character-driven storytelling - someone who understands timing, performance, and visual comedy while still delivering cinematic scale and polish.

This is a highly collaborative role working alongside our existing directors and discipline leads to brainstorm, rapidly pitch, and bring ideas to life. You'll manage multiple trailers simultaneously while incorporating feedback from Marketing, Art Direction, Game Direction, and other partners without compromising the creative intent.

In this role, you will

  • Collaborate with our directors and discipline leads to define the creative vision, story, tone, and visual language for Fortnite cinematic trailers and short-form content.
  • Develop and pitch original story and comedy ideas, taking them from early concept through final delivery.
  • Work hands-on in Unreal Engine 5, building and iterating sequences in Sequencer.
  • Translate scripts and storyboards into compelling shots through composition, camera movement, performance, pacing, and visual comedy.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while synthesizing feedback from Marketing, Art Direction, Game Direction, and other creative partners.
  • Partner across Animation, Layout, Lighting, FX, Production, and Technical Art to bring the creative vision to life.
  • Collaborate with the Animat

jobs.title: Counsel (Regulatory)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

LEGAL

What We Do

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

What You'll Do

Epic's regulatory lawyers advise the company on laws and regulations worldwide. We partner with Public Policy to monitor regulatory developments and support advocacy on regulatory design; with Product Counsel on new products and their regulatory requirements; and with Compliance on the design and operation of our regulatory compliance program. We also help manage the company's response to regulatory inquiries, investigations and RFIS.

In this role, you will

  • Advise Product Counsel, Compliance and Legal leadership on global laws and regulations, with the focus of this role being on online safety frameworks such as the UK Online Safety Act and EU Digital Services Act
  • Monitor and analyse draft legislation and regulatory proposals, supporting Public Policy's advocacy efforts
  • Advise Product Counsel on new products and features and their regulatory requirements
  • Support Compliance in the operation of our regulatory compliance program and compliance strategies
  • Help manage the company's response to regulatory oversight, such as supervisory meetings and RFIs

What we're looking for

  • Qualified attorney with 5+ years experience working in regulatory compliance, either within a regulatory body, in-house or at a law firm
  • Experience with online safety regulation in the UK and/or EU
  • Knowledge of the tech industry; familiarity with video games is an advantage
  • Ability/flexibility to work US Eastern time hours
  • Comfort working with multiple stakeholders, navigating complex issues, and leading high-impact projects
  • Sound judgement and decision-making in ambiguous situations where clear guidance may be limited or non-existent
  • Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to deliver under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach

This role is open to multiple locations in Europe.

Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

Epic's Cyber Defense Operations team protects one of the world's largest player communities, as well as the people, infrastructure, and technology that support it. As Cyber Defense Operations Director, you will own Epic's detection and response function end-to-end, leading the teams who detect, investigate, and respond to threats across the company. You will set the long-term vision for security operations, build an organization that scales with Epic's growth, and lead the shift to automated, Al-assisted operations so the team can focus on the threats that matter most. This is a player-coach role: you will lead from the front, stay hands-on alongside the team, and hold yourself to the same high standard you set for others.

In this role, you will

  • Build and lead the Cyber Defense Operations organization as a hands-on player-coach: hire and develop strong analysts, set the org structure, and stay in the work on investigations, detection, and major incidents. Coach the team through real cases, put their growth first, and clear the obstacles that slow them down
  • Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for detection, response, automation, and tooling, aligned with Epic's risk profile, business priorities, and Information Security leadership goals
  • Act as the senior incident lead for Epic's most significant security events, directing response across programming, legal, privacy, communications, and executive leadership, and briefing senior leaders on impact and risk
  • Own detection and response coverage across cloud, corporate, endpoint, identity, and production environments, directing investment toward the threats that pose the most risk to Epic
  • Champion automation and AI-agent workflows across security operations, partnering with security programming leadership to set guardrails, validation standards, and where human review is required
  • Run Cyber Defense Operations as a bus

jobs.title: Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

We're seeking a Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst to identify, investigate, and disrupt the people who cheat, defraud, or abuse Epic's games and players. You'll track cheat developers, account sellers, and fraud operations back to the people and infrastructure behind them, then work with Ecosystem Security and Legal to turn that research into mitigations, enforcement, and legal action. This role owns investigations from first lead to finished report with minimal oversight.

In this role, you will

  • Investigate cheat developers, sellers and resellers, account sellers, tournament cheaters, DDoS providers, and exploit developers targeting Epic's games
  • Identify the people, networks, and infrastructure behind cheat products and fraud schemes, not only the products themselves
  • Investigate fraud and abuse across the ecosystem, including V-Bucks fraud, Support-A-Creator fraud, and map payout fraud
  • Monitor cheat communities and underground markets for new features, techniques, and trends, and feed findings into technical mitigations and enforcement decisions
  • Track account compromise methods and social engineering tactics used against players
  • Research and maintain Epic's gaming threat landscape, including the leading threat actors, their methods, and where they are likely to move next
  • Prioritize actors by impact and build evidence packages that support takedowns, payment disruption, and litigation, and support Legal throughout the legal process
  • Work with external intel partners on reporting, cheat testing, and attribution, and exchange intelligence with gaming industry peers
  • Support incident response with research on cheats, exploits, compromised accounts, and leaks
  • Write case reports and contribute to quarterly threat reporting, and own small projects from the team backlog end to end

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Cosmetics Lead, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Fortnite. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modeling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modelling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner
  • Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly

Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Cosmetics Lead, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Fortnite. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modelling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modeling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner
  • Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly
