What We Do

We deliver the most innovative gaming experiences possible to players around the world. Whether through community outreach, world-class events, or partnership integrations, the Epic Games Publishing and Marketing teams seek to surprise players with new experiences every time they drop in to play.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking a highly strategic, culturally fluent, and operationally rigorous Influencer Marketing Director to lead creator and talent partnerships across Fortnite. This role will shape how creators, streamers, athletes, musicians, entertainers, and their communities connect with Fortnite through major launches, live-service moments, partnerships, and creator campaigns.

The ideal candidate combines deep fluency in the Fortnite creator ecosystem with strong strategic judgment, communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. This person should understand both gaming culture and broader entertainment ecosystems, and be equally comfortable building creator strategy, managing high-profile talent relationships, and navigating complex cross-functional initiatives.

In this role, you will

  • Develop and lead creator and influencer strategies tied to Fortnite launches, partnerships, live-service beats, and major campaigns
  • Translate brand and business objectives into measurable creator programs that drive audience engagement, conversation, and commercial impact
  • Build and manage relationships with key gaming creators, streamers, athletes, entertainers, agents, and talent representatives across multiple verticals
  • Lead high-profile creator and talent integrations from planning through execution, including negotiations, hospitality, experiential activations, and content coordination
  • Present creator strategies, talent recommendations, and campaign plans clearly and concisely to senior leadership
  • Partner cross-functionally across Paid Media, Brand Marketing, Competitive, IP Partnerships teams and external partners to deliver cohesive global campaigns
  • Manage agency partners and oversee campaign execution to ensure work meets Epic’s creative, operational, and business standards

We are seeking an experienced Lead Gameplay Programmer to direct gameplay teams within Rocket League. They will be responsible for leading the gameplay programming team and collaborating and iterating with gameplay programmers, game designers, producers, and artists. They will play a critical role in feature development for Rocket League.

In this role, you will

  • Manage a team of seasoned gameplay programmers and be the primary hub of communication and information for other disciplines
  • Distill high-level feature requests into meaningful, actionable work items and delegate effectively to the team
  • Deliver core gameplay features efficiently and on time, and speak up when the team is overor under-scoped
  • Lead the vision for different gameplay systems and features and write code and do system design as needed
  • Propose and review technical design, systems, and technical approaches to ensure that they satisfy requirements and promote a healthy codebase
  • Work closely with art and design leads to ensure gameplay mechanics meet functional requirements and uphold our high standards
  • Work closely with other programming disciplines to integrate systems in support of the player experience

What we're looking for

  • Experience developing gameplay physics systems (simulation, collision, character/vehicle physics, etc.)
  • Experience with network replication systems (client-server prediction, state synchronization, lag compensation)
  • Proven track record delivering live-service games or AAA MMO titles built on Unreal Engine
  • Proven leadership experience managing high-performing programming teams on shipped AAA titles
  • Strong C++ skills and the ability to code and design gameplay mechanics and tools
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, as well

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Lead Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement to join our team. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to Fortnite and other initiatives as part of our collaboration with Disney. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact cosmetic assets and gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production
  • Communicate and drive alignment around strategy for technical animation and adjacent cosmetics teams
  • Work with production to schedule, prioritize, and delegate assets for the team, both internal and vendor
  • Work closely with animators, modelers, and designers to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets
  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Mentor rigging-focused technical animators
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver

Epic Games is looking for a Level Design intern to work with our gameplay team on an unannounced project in the Fortnite ecosystem.   • Passion for games with a wide breadth of game knowledge
  • Strong interest in BR and multiplayer games with an understanding of what makes them work

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Memory
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

  • Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products
  • Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance
  • Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms
  • Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

  • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
    • Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
    • Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling
    • Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
  • Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of programming experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

  • Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products
  • Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance
  • Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms
  • Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

  • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
    • Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
    • Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling
    • Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
  • Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

jobs.title: Principal Animator
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Principal Animator to join our Fortnite team and help shape the future of gameplay animation. In this highly influential, hands-on role, you'll create exceptional keyframed gameplay animation, build playable prototypes that explore new ideas for Fortnite, and help develop innovative animation techniques, tools, and emerging workflows. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in gameplay animation, strong creative and technical instincts, and a passion for exploring AI-assisted animation technologies. You'll collaborate across disciplines to elevate animation quality, explore new gameplay possibilities, and help define the next generation of animation workflows within Fortnite.

In this role, you will

  • Own gameplay animation from initial concept through implementation in Unreal Engine 5, with a focus on gameplay feel, responsiveness, style, and visual appeal
  • Independently come up with new gameplay ideas, build playable prototypes, and iterate on them through playtesting. Bring a strong sense of what makes Fortnite fun and where there's room to take it in new directions
  • Champion AI-assisted animation technologies and emerging workflows, identifying opportunities to enhance animation quality, creativity, and production efficiency
  • Experiment with, prototype, and help integrate innovative animation tools and techniques into Fortnite's animation pipelines
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in gameplay animation, providing creative and technical direction across teams while remaining deeply hands-on
  • Partner closely with Design, Engineering, Technical Animation, Technical Design, and Production to solve complex animation challenges and influence long-term animation strategies
  • Establish best practices, mentor animators, and raise the bar for animation quality, technical execution, and workflow innovation
  • Create and refine stylized and realistic gameplay animation in Unreal Engine 5 using Control Rig and Animation Blueprints

jobs.title: Principal Backend Programmer (Developer Platform)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ONLINE INFRASTRUCTURE

What We Do

We enable Epic’s online services teams to build, deploy, and manage services that are used by more than half a billion players around the world. Our mission is to provide world class tools and platforms to improve the experience of our developers and make it easier, faster, and safer to build, operate, and scale their applications. We operate at massive scale as one of the largest cloud computing users in the world.

What You'll Do

You'll be the senior technical voice across Epic's developer platform: the source control, CI/CD, build, artifact, database and cloud infrastructure that teams across Epic use to build and ship their work. You'll look at problems across systems and teams, and set the technical strategy for where the platform needs to go. The primary focus of this role is rebuilding and scaling our systems to handle millions of agentic CICD actions per day. You'll work across teams to understand their requirements and usage patterns, negotiate trade-offs with cost and feasibility in mind, and build and deploy the changes needed. Beyond that, this is a role for someone we can point at a hard, ambiguous problem in any domain or team and trust to understand it, decide what to do, and get it solved, whether that means designing the system and building it yourself, or bringing the right people together. Epic is an agentic-programming-first company. You'll be expected to use Al coding tools and agents as a normal part of how you work, and help shape how we apply them to our own infrastructure.

In this role, you will

  • Set the forward-looking technical strategy and design for the developer platform, across source control, CI/CD, build, artifact management, developer tooling, and cloud infrastructure
  • Define the strategy for software supply chain and pipeline security, and partner with the security and governance teams to deliver it
  • Take on the hardest cross-team problems, whatever the domain: dig in, find the real issue, decide on an approach and see it through to a working solution
  • Stay hands-on where it matters, building prototypes, writing critical code and reviewing designs
  • Write clear strategy documents, design proposals and decision records that leadership and programmers can act on

We ship features for kids and parents, review product updates across the company for safety and privacy considerations, collaborate with legal to translate regulatory requirements to an actionable product roadmap, and provide insights to our partner teams grounded in primary research we conduct with parents and players. This Product Management Director role will own complex, cross-product initiatives on the FamXP roadmap, set priorities for the FamXP team, and set the standard for how the FamXP product team operates.

In this role, you will

  • Drive FamXP initiatives from strategy through design, build, and launch, in partnership with engineering, QA, design, legal, policy, and analytics counterparts across multiple Epic product surfaces

jobs.title: Release Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a quality-focused Senior Release Manager to work closely with our producers, programmers, build engineers, and QA teams to oversee the build and release process for the Fortnite Ecosystem. In this position, you will work directly with the brightest technical minds in the business as we build the premier game engine for a multitude of platforms.

In this role, you will

  • Develop new practices and structures to better scale release management and stabilization processes across our Game Dev ecosystem, while managing a sub-team of release managers
  • Own the scheduling, coordination, quality control, and external certification process across multiple platforms and/or products
  • Act as the liaison between multiple development teams, coordinating and negotiating development plans, exceptions, sales/mktg/publishing content, as well as releases
  • Work with the publishing and development teams to determine release content plans as related to sales, giveaways, promotions, etc., and shepherd that content through external party approvals for release
  • Work closely with QA, Build Engineers, and Lead Programmers to monitor the automated build and integration process, facilitate the resolution of build failures, and understand and communicate the impact of branches and code merges
  • Partner with QA Leads to establish and maintain the bug triage process and prioritize must-fix issues, coordinate internal and external release notes, known issues, and knowledge base updates, and ensure releases have passed all required checks and approvals leading up to live deployment, while communicating approved exceptions to all necessary parties

What we're looking for

  • Strong production/project management skills, communication skills, and people management/direct report experience
  • Demonstrated ability in right-sized process development and improvement
  • Experience with build and release processes for Software or Games as a Service

What We Do

We enable Epic’s online services teams to build, deploy, and manage services that are used by more than half a billion players around the world. Our mission is to provide world class tools and platforms to improve the experience of our developers and make it easier, faster, and safer to build, operate, and scale their applications. We operate at massive scale as one of the largest cloud computing users in the world.

What You'll Do

You'll own the backend systems behind Epic's CI/CD and build tooling and the cloud infrastructure they run on. These systems carry code from commit to production for teams across Epic, so they need to be fast, reliable and secure. Your primary focus is software supply chain security: securing the pipelines, runners and artifact stores that build and ship our software, working closely with our security and governance teams. This is a hands-on technical lead role. You'll spend most of your time building and running systems yourself, while helping set the team's technical direction, architecture and goals. jobs.title: Senior Communications Manager, Corporate
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

COMMUNICATIONS

What We Do

The Epic Communications team advances the company’s narrative and represents Epic products and the company vision to external and internal audiences globally. We create positive relationships and engagement strategies with a wide range of audiences, including media, investors, influencers, and policymakers.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for an experienced communications professional to join our corporate communications and international team. In this role you will create and execute communications plans around high stakes policy, legal and regulatory developments, that impact Epic and the video game industry at large.

In this role, you will

  • Create proactive and reactive communications strategies on priority policy, regulatory and legal developments, such as online safety
  • Partner with the public policy team on impactful public affairs campaigns globally to build understanding of and support for our products and safety approaches
  • Partner with Epic’s Trust and Safety team on storytelling around our industry-leading approach to online safety and product features
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop proactive storytelling opportunities around Epic’s business, products, and technology in Latin America and Canada
  • Educate external stakeholders including third parties and media about Epic’s public policy and regulatory priorities
  • Establish and maintain relationships with journalists globally including technology, business and policy media on behalf of Epic
  • Be part of the team that manages Epic’s rapid response efforts, working in fast-paced environments to address issues with players, consumers, and policy makers

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in communications or public relations, preferably a mix of in-house and agency and/or political organizations
  • Experience driving communications and advocacy strategies around complex public policy issues
  • Experience working on rapid response with internal stakeholders
  • Experience managing global agency partners
  • Someone who moves fast, is focused on delivering results, and has a track record of working well across a diverse group of internal and external partners</

jobs.title: Senior Counsel (Regulatory)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

LEGAL

What We Do

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

What You'll Do

Epic’s regulatory team advises the company on newly enacted laws and regulations around the world as well as works alongside our Public Policy Team to monitor regulatory developments. Partnering closely with our subject matter experts, Product Counsel and Compliance Team, you will manage the design of compliance programs and educate counsel regarding regulatory requirements. You will also assist with the company’s response to regulatory investigations and requests for information from regulators.

In this role, you will

  • Advise Epic senior management, Product Counsel, the Compliance Team and Legal leadership on key global laws and regulations, including online safety frameworks
  • Lead multi-stakeholder regulatory compliance strategies
  • Provide legal analysis of legislative and regulatory drafts to the Public Policy team
  • Support advocacy and engagement with regulators and trade associations
  • Respond to global regulatory inquiries and investigations

What we're looking for

  • A qualified attorney with at least 8 years of experience working in regulatory compliance, either within a regulatory body, in-house or at a law firm
  • Experience handling regulatory enforcement actions brought by regulatory bodies
  • Prior work and/or substantial knowledge of the tech industry; A good working knowledge of tech or videogames is an advantage
  • An individual who is comfortable working in a multi-stakeholder environment, navigating complex issues, driving high-risk/impact projects, and working and making sound judgments and decisions in ambiguous situations where clear guidance is lacking or may not exist
  • Must be able to work proactively, independently, and reliably under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with a broad range of individuals and teams

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA).

jobs.description:

ANALYTICS

What We Do

Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Transparency and Regulatory, to join the Analytics team, where you will own the data and drive data tooling behind transparency reports Epic publishes under regulations such as the DSA, and support risk assessments, audits, compliance assessments, and other compliance reporting. You'll work with Legal, Compliance, Trust and Safety, and data engineering to turn regulatory requirements into clear metric definitions, bring in the figures other teams hold, and check every number before it is published.

In this role, you will

  • Own the data for transparency reports, risk assessments, and other compliance reporting across our products like Fortnite, the Epic Games Store, and Fab; from data requests to published figures
  • Work with Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and Trust and Safety policy teams to turn regulatory text into productionalized metric definitions
  • Map Epic's internal moderation data to regulatory categories, and work with product and engineering teams so new features capture what a regulatory report may need before launch
  • Partner with Data Engineering to drive the templates and validation tooling that other teams use to submit their data
  • Review the reporting pipeline's data quality checks every month, and work with Data Engineering to fix drift and defects, and add new moderation flows
  • Drive reporting methodology in partnership with leadership across the company

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or in a related field, including 2+ years with Trust and Safety, integrity, risk, compliance, or regulatory reporting data
  • Expertise with SQL, Python, and big data technologies such as Spark or Databricks
  • Experience turning legal, policy, or regulatory language into precise metric definitions, documented well enough for someone else to audit
  • Hands-on work on transparency repor

  • Oversee design and development from start to finish - From leading ideation with the team and shaping a timeline of engagement across the whole season, to making tough decisions on quality and scope throughout production

jobs.title: Senior Engine Programmer, Verse Framework
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Verse Framework Integration team is bringing the next major iteration of Unreal Engine to life, enabling creators to build the next generation of interactive experiences. You'll play a central role connecting many aspects of the engine, helping shape how Verse integrates with core engine systems.

In this role, you will

  • Design and implement low-level engine systems across Scene Graph, networking, analytics, and the language toolchain, with a focus on robustness, performance, and usability
  • Design stable, forward-thinking APIs that expose engine capabilities through Verse, for both internal and external developers
  • Collaborate across core engine and other framework teams as well as the Verse language team to build solutions that meet diverse and evolving needs
  • Help shape and unlock the capabilities of Verse within Unreal Engine
  • Drive technical excellence across platforms, including debugging, optimization, and system reliability

What we're looking for

  • Expert level C++ skills with the ability to design game engine systems and associated tools
  • Experience creating and maintaining APIs with exceptionally strong backward compatibility requirements
  • Diverse experience with and enthusiasm for applying that same backward compatibility rigor to stored data: serialization formats, schema evolution, and safely migrating live player data
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to find solutions beyond established approaches
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating with teams to define deliverables
  • Comfortable working in any low level engine system, even those outside of your comfort zone
  • Experience with multiple programming languages and a track record of leveraging their strengths effectively
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience writing performant code across multiple hardware platforms, including game consoles

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling gameplay experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, programming, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on gameplay systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

  • Work in close collaboration with project leads & directors to design, prototype, tune, and ship features and systems that support the engagement, gameplay, and creative vision of the project
  • Document and create clear, actionable design documents, and iterate on these features, working with a team of developers across multiple disciplines, and oversee their successful implementation from start to finish
  • Get hands-on creating the scripting, data, and content required by those features, diving into the engine, and leveraging other tools
  • Be responsible for soliciting and rapidly integrating feedback from across the team on your own initiative, ensuring we’re continually delivering a fun and fresh experience to our players
  • Help establish and maintain design pipelines, best practices, and cross-discipline communication standards to scope, prioritize deliverables, and hit milestone goals

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
  • Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System

  • Expert knowledge of C++17 or later

  • Strong ability to reason about large, interconnected systems
  • Solid grounding in software programming principles, including API design

ANALYTICS

What We Do

Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.

What You'll Do

You will design, build, and optimize the recommendation systems that power Fortnite's Discover experience, serving personalized recommendations to one of the largest player bases in gaming across a massive catalog of creator-built experiences.

You'll work across the full recommendation stack: candidate generation, content ranking, impression allocation, and real-time reranking.

Unlike recommendation systems that operate over a stable catalog, you're working with a massive, rapidly changing content library where new experiences are published daily, quality signals are sparse, and the system's own outputs shape the data it learns from.

In this role, you will

  • Design and implement retrieval, ranking, and reranking models for creator content using deep learning approaches (two-tower architectures, transformer-based sequence models, embedding-based retrieval) and build the user representation systems that power personalized discovery
  • Build and optimize multi-stage candidate generation and impression allocation pipelines that balance relevance, diversity, and fair content exposure across a large and rapidly evolving catalog
  • Design and run A/B experiments to validate model improvements, own evaluation frameworks that capture recommendation quality holistically, and drive the path from experiment to production deployment
  • Collaborate with analytics and content quality teams on ranking signals including genre classification, creator credibility, and content quality metrics
  • Own ML infrastructure decisions: choosing the right tradeoffs between batch, near-real-time, and streaming serving architectures

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building production recommendation or ranking systems, ideally in a UGC, marketplace, or content discovery context
  • Experience with deep learning for information retrieval and multi-stage recommendation pipelines (candidate generation, scoring, reranking)

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

InfoSec at Epic is rethinking how security gets done, replacing manual processes with automated, Al-driven systems that scale with the business. As a senior engineer reporting directly to InfoSec leadership, you will design and build the platforms that define the future of security engineering at Epic, turning hard problems into reliable, enterprise-grade solutions that teams across the company depend on.

In this role, you will

  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities to automate security operations, then independently design, build, and ship the solution end to end

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Senior Tech Artist to join our team working on Fortnite Events. A successful candidate should have a deep knowledge in look development, lighting and complex game art. A successful candidate should have a broad knowledge of art creation for games. You should understand modeling, texturing, and animation fundamentals. You should be able to combine geometry, materials, effects, and UE Blueprints to create complex art. You should be able to work with both internal ICs, leads and directors as well as direct vendors to support the more technical aspects of creating art.

In this role, you will

  • Create complex materials for landscape and environments
  • Be responsible for world lighting, sets lighting, clouds, atmospherics, water lookdev
  • Execute on a range of visual styles with emphasis on stylized with a high level of fidelity
  • Work with engineers and artists to optimize content for many platforms
  • Own gameplay and engine features from the TechArt side maintaining the high-quality bar for Fortnite Events

What we're looking for

  • Must have a strong reel/portfolio showing executed game tech art
  • Experienced knowledge of PBR principles and material editors
  • Establish workflows and tools for other artists to utilize when making unique assets
  • Experience using texturing packagers such as Substance Designer
  • High level of proficiency in setting up world environmental lighting
  • Desire and knowledge of how to push Unreal Engine further
  • Desire to work with a team and own features and initiatives from inception to ship
  • Familiarity with the Unreal 5 Engine art pipeline
  • Experience working on multiple platforms
  • Scripting experience Blueprint or other

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA).

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma is evolving the Customer Support experience, powered by AI, automation, and integrated systems. As a Support Engineer, AI & Automations on the Support Technology Team, you'll design, build, and operationalize integrations across systems like Decagon, Zendesk, Figma admin tooling, and adjacent Customer Support platforms, bringing the right context into customer conversations and automating complex workflows. You'll turn ambiguous support problems into working technical solutions, combining applied AI engineering with strong software development to connect conversational systems to the context, tools, and backend capabilities they need to act. Automated Actions is one of Product Support's most important initiatives for 2027, and your work will help resolve requests that currently require manual intervention, giving our Support Specialists more time for complex customer needs.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Build and operate automated actions that AI agents can invoke to resolve customer issues and complete support tasks, using clear tool definitions, structured inputs and outputs, and reliable execution logic.
  • Develop reusable integrations connecting Decagon and other support platforms to Figma's internal systems, relevant customer and account data, and approved backend capabilities.
  • Design permission-aware actions with authentication, input validation, policy checks, appropriate human approval, and safeguards that prevent unintended or duplicate actions.
  • Define expected behavior and failure paths, and validate the experience end to end; contribute to conversational design and workflow testing when needed.
  • Own technical testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Evaluate and debug AI behavior across tool selection, action inputs, execution, and results, and turn what you learn into improvements.
  • Work with Support, Analytics, Engineering, and Security to prioritize opportunities, resolve dependencies, and measure successful task completion, resolution quality, customer effort, and realized capacity gains.

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered applications or agents that use tools and APIs to execute actions and complete tasks in production.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

"현장의 가장 깊숙한 곳에 투입되어, AI로 비즈니스 병목을 파괴하는 스페셜리스트"

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여 임직원들의 일하는 방식(Work & Workflow)을 혁신하는 핵심 조직입니다.

현업(게임 제작 스튜디오, 글로벌 퍼블리싱, 백오피스 등)의 한가운데로 직접 투입되어, 그들이 겪는 치명적인 비즈니스 Pain Point를 발굴하고 AI 기술을 통해 즉각적인 솔루션을 만들어냅니다. 전사 AI 해커톤을 이끌고, 최단 시간 내에 MVP(최소 기능 제품)를 런칭하여 '기술이 어떻게 재무적/시간적 성과로 이어지는지'를 현장에서 직접 증명해 낼 강인하고 속도감 있는 Transformation Specialist을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • AI 혁신 전략 수립 및 자문: 현업 부서의 비즈니스 과제를 분석하여 AI 적용 전략을 독자적으로 수립하고, 기술적 방향성 및 우선순위에 대한 전문적 자문 제시
  • 비즈니스 요구사항 분석 및 아키텍처 설계: 비개발 직군(기획, 재무, HR 등)의 복잡한 요구사항을 정확히 분석·해석하고, 이를 AI 기반의 아키텍처로 설계 및 구현
  • AI 기술 도입 타당성 연구 및 ROI 분석: 도입된 AI 기술의 실제 비용 절감 및 업무 시간 단축 효과를 정량적으로 분석·연구하고, 성공 사례를 전사 스케일업(Scale-up) 전략으로 기획
  • 현업 밀착형 AI 프로토타이핑 및 해커톤 기획: 현업 부서와 직접 호흡하며 비즈니스 문제를 정의하고, 단기간(며칠~몇 주) 내에 AI 에이전트 및 자동화 앱을 설계·프로토타이핑하여 기술 검증 수행 (사내 AI 해커톤 등 전사 혁신 이니셔티브 기술 총괄 포함)

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 실무 경력을 바탕으로, 개발 팀이나 목적 조직(TF)을 리딩하여 프로젝트를 성공적으로 완수한 경험이 있으신 분

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
About Invisix

Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data.  We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. Our culture is professional and fast-paced, with short communication lines and a strong sense of shared purpose. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger.

The Role

We're looking for a System Architect to decide what our metrology equipment is and why it's built that way: concept choices, system decomposition, budget allocations and the technology roadmap amongst others.  Reporting to our CTO, you look two to five years ahead and beyond, and shape our product line across several generations, so that what we build today still makes sense for our customers tomorrow. You work with our customers' technology roadmaps, marketing, the heads of R&D, our function architects and customer support, and you lead through persuasion rather than formal authority. Our system engineer builds on your concept and makes the current program work to spec. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe.

Own the system architecture of our metrology product line, looking two to five years ahead and beyond, across several product generations

Make and justify the key concept choices, weighing physics, performance, cost and risk

Decompose the system into modules and interfaces, and allocate the key budgets, such as throughput, cost of goods, availability and performance

Translate our customers' technology roadmaps and future needs into product requirements, together with marketing and customers

Define our platform and reuse strategy, and decide which technologies we invest in

Align the heads of R&D and our function architects behind the architecture, and take on adjacent responsibilities as the company grows, such as representing Invisix in technical discussions with customers and partners

Is this you?

MSc or PhD in physics, applied physics, electrical or mechanical engineering or a related field, with at least 10 years of experience developing complex high-tech equipment, including a role as system or product architect

Experience in semiconductor equipment, for example lithography, metrology or inspection, or in comparable high-tech equipment, ideally with a product that made it to customers

Strong physics depth, in optics or measurement physics, so you can judge concept choices on their physical merits

Experience making architecture trade-offs across mechanics, electronics, optics and software, and setting system budgets for performance, throughput and cost

Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data.  We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. Our culture is professional and fast-paced, with short communication lines and a strong sense of shared purpose. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger.

The Role

We're looking for a System Engineer to make our metrology equipment work to spec in a real program: requirements, error budgets, integration and verification, and system-level problem solving amongst others.  Reporting to our CTO, you take a program or release of our product, or a subsystem of it, from requirements to a tool that passes customer acceptance and ships on time. You work with our module and discipline engineers, integration, quality and service, and you're the technical contact for customers on specifications, acceptance criteria and escalations. Our system architect owns the concept; you make it work and prove it. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe.

Agree specifications and acceptance criteria with the system architect, handle technical escalations, and take on adjacent responsibilities as the company grows, such as system engineering for a next product release

Is this you?

MSc or PhD in physics, applied physics, mechatronics, electrical engineering or a related field, with at least 5 years of experience in system engineering for complex high-tech equipment

Experience in semiconductor equipment, for example lithography, metrology or inspection, or in comparable high-tech equipment

A solid physics background, especially in optics or measurement physics, so you can understand and quantify what limits system performance

Hands-on experience with requirements breakdown and traceability, error budgets, and integration, verification and qualification plans

Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE), for example with SysML

A rigorous, data-driven and systematic way of working, and enough depth in several disciplines to debug across them

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

jobs.title: AI Safety Residency — Scale Labs Preparedness & Policy (SLPreP)
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with the Preparedness and Policy research team, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

The work includes thinking about various failure modes, evaluating whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Residents take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide AI safety residents on projects in AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AI systems, including monitoring their reasoning to detect harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment red-teaming: Developing science around testing whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: Examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: A benchmark with task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: evaluating whether language models choose harmful actions when given simulated dangerous tools under various operational pressures
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • RSI Control: evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage R&D efforts in the RSI loop.

See more work from the Human Frontier Collective.

jobs.title: SWE Fellow - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think. We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who Should Apply

  • Professional and Academic Background: 5+ years of software engineering or related technical experience, or equivalent domain expertise through academic work (e.g. PhD, postdoctoral research, or faculty experience in Computer Science or related field).
  • Skills: Demonstrated coding proficiency and analytical abilities, with deep expertise in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, Java, Rust, Swift, JavaScript, or C++.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion in applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
  • Work authorization

jobs.description:
About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) focused on Inference & Post-Training, you will be a hands-on technical partner to our most strategic customers — production AI teams looking to leverage high quality models and do inference at scale. For us, FDE is not a replacement for a Solutions Architect; you will partner with our SAs as a deep-domain specialist in inference optimization, fine-tuning pipelines, and production deployment. As key contributors to both the CX, Engineering, and Sales organizations, FDEs add tremendous value by ensuring we can meet the requirements of our most complex POCs, facilitate successful platform adoption, and guide tailored optimization efforts — directly impacting customer success, company growth, and the hardening of our core platform.

Must be a permanent resident or citizen of Singapore.

Responsibilities

  • Inference Engine Optimization: Select, configure, and optimize inference engine based on hardware, model architecture, and workload profile
  • Configuration & Performance Tuning: Develop configuration updates to win critical POCs, benchmarks, and optimize customer deployments; tune KV cache, apply speculative decoding, determine optimal tensor parallelism, and determine quantization strategy to hit throughput and latency targets.
  • Post-Training & Fine-Tuning: Drive hands-on RL training runs and optimize system design; guide customers through LoRA, SFT, DPO, RLHF, and GRPO pipelines from experimentation through production.
  • Strategic Customer Alignment: Act as the primary technical point of contact for aligned strategic accounts — monitoring and optimizing endpoint configurations, helping customers get the most out of the platform, and collaborating to ensure we hit critical milestones.
  • Opinionated Onboarding: Establish direct alignment with strategic customers at onboarding; ensure the right inference and post-training configurations are in place from day one to improve time-to-value.
  • Product Feedback Loop: Directly influence our software and model roadmap by surfacing insights from the field. Contribute back to the product where needed to support customer requirements or drive a better experience. Drive early feature and research adoption with strategic logos.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in a technical role, with a strong focus on inference systems, open-source LLM deployment, or post-training workflows.
  • Inference Engine Depth: Expert-level, hands-on experience with inference engines (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang); ability to diagnose and resolve performance issues at the engine level.
  • Inference Optimization: Deep knowledge of KV cache tuning, speculative decoding, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and quantization techniques
  • Post-Training Knowledge: Hands-on experience with fine-tuning and post-trainin

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Applied AI Inference team, you’ll be the hands-on technical owner for a broad set of fast-growing customers building products on high-quality open models at scale. You’ll work across several customers and get into the details of how each customer selects and applies models in their workload, from evals and prompts to agents and harness integrations.

You’ll go deep technically. You’ll learn each customer’s architecture and use cases well enough to guide their move from closed to open models. That means choosing the right models, benchmarking quality and performance, tuning prompts and pipelines, and integrating models into their systems and workflows. You’ll write code most days, alongside customers and in our own tools.

You’ll own customer outcomes from post-POC to production. Once a Solutions Architect wins the proof of concept, you take the account into production and help it scale. You drive adoption, remove blockers and proactively make sure the customer gets the value they were promised.

You’ll bring a product mindset. You’ll turn what you learn on each deployment into reusable playbooks, tooling, reference architectures and product feedback so each new deployment is faster and needs less manual work than the last.

You’ll work across teams constantly. You’ll work alongside Solutions Architects, Sales, Engineering, Product, and Research.

As one of the early members on this team, you’ll also help define how the function runs, including its playbooks, tooling and hiring. Your work will directly affect customer retention, platform adoption and company growth.

Responsibilities

  • Opinionated Onboarding: Plan the path to production with the SA and customer, and make sure the right deployment strategy, model choice, ramp plan and monitoring are in place before the workload goes live.
  • Model Selection & Migration: Help customers move from closed to open models. Evaluate options on the customer’s own data, pick the right model, and handle upgrades and deprecations without regressions.
  • Agent Design: Build and debug agents and multi-step workflows that hold up in production, including tool calling, planning and retries.
  • Harness & System Integrations: Get Together working inside the tools customers already use, like coding-agent harnesses, agent frameworks, OpenAI-compatible SDKs and data pipelines. Fix what breaks between them: tool-call formats, streaming, context limits and rate limits.
  • Evals & Prompts: Build evals that measure what each customer cares about, and use them to tune prompts and catch regressions.
  • Customer Touchpoints: Proactively monitor your accounts, keep a frequent pulse of how things are going, work closely alongside customers

jobs.description:

Together AI is scaling its go-to-market team fast, and we need a Head of Sales Enablement to make every seller, solutions architect, and customer-facing engineer audible-ready, from their first week through every launch.

Our products are deeply technical: inference, post-training, GPU infrastructure, and the research behind them. Many of the people we hire will come from adjacent domains, not just AI infrastructure. Your job is to close that gap quickly and keep the field sharp as the platform evolves.

This is not a role for someone who manages a program from a distance. You'll get in the trenches with the field: join customer calls, hear objections first-hand, and turn what works into training the whole team can use. You'll own field readiness end to end and be accountable for results.

  • Embed deeply with the sales and SA team to understand what enablement and content is needed to adapt to changing market conditions and drive execution.

jobs.title: Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern (Masters/PhD) - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is passionate about protecting the integrity of multiplayer games and creating a fair experience for players. We work across low-level systems, software protection, and security research to help protect the legitimacy of players’ games.

As an Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern, you’ll work with experienced Vanguard engineers on a summer research project exploring how agentic AI is changing the effectiveness of software obfuscation and virtualization. With mentorship from the team, you’ll use and improve research harnesses that iteratively challenge code-protection techniques, measure the boundaries of AI-assisted reverse engineering, and investigate methods for making protected code more resilient to AI analysis. You’ll turn your findings into repeatable experiments, clear technical documentation, and make recommendations that inform the future of Anti-Cheat and client software protection.

Potential Responsibilities:

  • Work with Anti-Cheat engineers to scope and complete a bounded research project focused on AI-assisted analysis of obfuscated and virtualized code.
  • Build and improve AI harnesses that iteratively improve and challenge code-protection techniques to study the boundaries of their design
  • Design and run experiments that measure where AI systems succeed, struggle, or fail when reasoning about protected binaries.
  • Research and evaluate techniques that make software obfuscation and virtualization more resilient to AI-assisted reverse engineering.
  • Reproduce and validate results, documenting experimental methods, evidence, limitations, and potential defensive implications.
  • Contribute improvements to shared research tools and workflows, and present progress and findings to engineers and technical partners.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a Masters or Doctoral program in the following fields: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related graduate degree program.
  • Experience programming in C or C++, demonstrated through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects.
  • Experience with agentic AI tools or harnesses used to automate iterative workflows such as code generation, testing, analysis, or evaluation.
  • Foundational understanding and relevant coursework in operating systems, computer architecture, compilers, and software security.
  • Available to work full-time hours for the 12-week program.
  • Minimum GPA of 2.5.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Graduating in the 2028 calendar year.
  • Exposure to reverse engineering, binary analysis, code obfuscation, software virtualization, or related security techniques through coursework or hands-on projects.
  • Experience with Python, scripting, Git, testing, or building repeatable research and evaluation tools.
  • Familiarity with program-analysis

jobs.title: Rendering Technical Artist II - League of Legends (Contract)
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title, League of Legends, to critical and player acclaim. Players form the foundation of our community, and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. That’s where you come in.

As a Rendering Technical Artist (Contract) on the Singapore League of Legends PC Team, you’ll help bring the world of Runeterra and beyond to life through materials, lighting, and real-time rendering. League’s visual targets are built on a modern real-time, PBR-based rendering pipeline with stylized, hand-painted treatments, and you’ll author, extend, and maintain the shaders and materials that realize them across champions, skins, and related content.

Working closely with artists, designers, engineers, and external partners, you’ll act as a bridge between art and engineering—translating visual and art-direction goals into robust, performant solutions that behave consistently across around-game and in-game environments. As an experienced technical artist, you’ll also diagnose rendering issues early, reduce rework, and help raise the craft bar for how shaders and materials are authored across internal and external teams.

Reporting to the Technical Art Manager, you will ensure that assets meet technical performance standards and artistic direction requirements. In collaboration with Art, Design, Engineering, and external partners, you will contribute to production support and workflow improvements.

Please note that Riot Games does not offer relocation packages for this position.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate directly with Art and Design to understand desired visual behaviors and art direction, and translate them into clear, achievable, and performant rendering solutions.
  • Provide hands-on technical support to internal and external vendor artists, helping them author, integrate, and troubleshoot materials and shaders for Epic and Legendary skins.

We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. jobs.title: Senior Concept Artist, Environment - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
我们以玩家体验为核心，致力于用创新技术为全球玩家带来卓越的游戏体验。作为 Unpublished R&D Product 团队的一员，你将与客户端、引擎、美术、设计及跨职能团队紧密合作，围绕 UE5 前沿能力开展研究与工程化实践，持续完善高品质、稳定高效的视觉设计流程。

我们正在寻找能够"构建设计体验，而不仅是绘制场景"的设计师。

作为一名优秀的场景设计师，你将从空间体验与视觉表达出发，定义环境设计的视觉语言，与美术、设计、叙事及技术团队紧密合作，打造兼具沉浸感、可读性与制作可行性的高品质环境内容。

我们希望你不仅具备出色的视觉表达能力，更具备系统化的空间设计思维，能够在艺术表现、设计需求与技术约束之间建立平衡。

You will report into the Creative Director of the team.

Responsibilities

Environment Design

  • 负责核心场景内容的概念设计，从草图探索到高完成度场景设定。
  • 探索并定义符合设计方向的环境视觉语言，包括地形结构、建筑风格、材质表现、色彩氛围等。
  • 构建具有高度辨识度和沉浸感的环境设计，支撑整体体验与视觉表达。

Design Systems & Methodology

  • 构建场景设计逻辑，包括空间布局、视觉语言、设计原则及叙事关联。
  • 建立并持续完善场景设计规范，包括尺度体系、模块化原则、细节密度及视觉引导等。
  • 在设计中平衡视觉表现、空间可读性及长期内容扩展需求。

Spatial Design & Collaboration

  • 与跨职能团队紧密合作，确保场景设计满足空间体验及整体设计目标。
  • 设计清晰的视觉引导与空间层级，提升整体体验及信息传达效率。
  • 在空间规划过程中充分考虑功能分区、视觉可读性及制作可行性。

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • 与3D场景美术、技术美术及技术团队密切合作，确保设计方案具备良好的制作可行性及稳定表现。
  • 提供清晰、可执行的设计交付，包括结构拆解、模块建议、材质指引等。
  • 持续跟进场景从概念到最终实现的整体质量。

Quality

  • 参与整体环境视觉风格建设，建立关键区域的视觉质量标准。
  • 根据产品需求及目标平台要求，平衡设计复杂度与制作成本。
  • 在探索阶段提供多方向设计方案，快速支持设计迭代。

jobs.title: Senior Game Producer 高级游戏项目管理经理 - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

我们正在寻找一位拥有极高专业素养和卓越领导力的高级游戏项目管理经理，来管理公司旗下游戏项目。
作为项目管理者，你不仅仅是进度的记录者，更是项目研发体系的架构师和变革者。你的核心使命是：通过科学的项目管理方法论，建立可预测、高效率、透明化的研发管线，确保项目按时、保质、可控地交付，从而将宏大的游戏愿景变为现实。

核心职责 (Responsibilities):

  • 【项目管理】 制定并确立项目的制作与管理标准，在推进研发进度的同时，重点关注高质量的交付、管线效能以及团队的健康状态。
  • 【风险预警】 提供清晰、透明的项目进度与管线健康度更新。敏锐地识别开发中的潜在风险，并协调核心利益相关者及时跟进、解决或升级问题。
  • 【流程优化】 开发并持续优化跨职能团队的工作流与沟通渠道。打通策划、美术、程序等不同部门间的协作壁垒，消除无效沟通和返工摩擦。
  • 【协同对齐】 促进各研发部门在排期和优先级上保持紧密对齐，确保责任落实，让团队的承诺都能转化为按时的交付。

任职要求 (Qualifications):

  • 经验要求： 8年以上游戏行业游戏自研经验，至少拥有3年以上管理经验（管理过 PM 或同等职能团队），有从零到一的项目经验优先。
  • 项目背景： 必须具备大型、复杂游戏项目的全周期研发管理经验。熟悉主流游戏引擎开发流程。
  • 专业认证： 精通敏捷开发模式，并能根据项目特点灵活融合。持有 PMP 或 ACP/CSM 认证者优先。
  • 工具精通： 专家级掌握 Jira 等项目管理工具、Excel/Tableau 等数据分析工具，并了解版本控制系统（如 Perforce/Git）及 CI/CD 流程。

加分项 (Pluses):

  • 英语流利，能适应国际化办公环境
  • 有全球化发行或跨国团队协作的项目管理经验。

jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

作为 Riot Games 的 Game Producer，我们通过专业的制作管理与跨职能协作，支持团队打造高质量的产品与体验，推动开发工作有序开展，并帮助团队持续改进工作方式。

作为 Unpublished R&D Product 团队的 Senior Game Producer，你将负责建立和完善研发阶段所需的制作管理基础体系，帮助团队在不断变化的工作环境中保持清晰的目标、灵活的执行方式和稳定的协作节奏。

你将制定和维护项目路线图，建立适合团队需求的开发管理流程与协作机制，主动识别潜在风险与依赖关系，并推动团队持续记录、总结和复用工作经验。

你将与团队管理者及不同专业领域的负责人紧密合作，协调跨职能工作，推动关键计划与里程碑落地，并与其他项目管理人员协同解决问题、持续优化团队的工作机制。

此外，你还将指导和培养项目管理团队成员，支持不同专业领域的同事改进工作流程、加强协作，并提升团队整体的执行效率。

你将向团队的 Director, Game Production 汇报工作。

核心职责（Responsibilities）

  • 制定并维护项目制作路线图： 负责为复杂、多阶段的研发项目制定清晰、完整的制作路线图，涵盖开发阶段、关键里程碑及阶段评审节点。将产品目标转化为不同时间维度下切实可行的执行计划，基于经验进行合理评估，并透明地沟通各项目标及里程碑的交付信心与潜在风险。确保团队计划与工作室及 Riot 整体规划保持一致。
  • 设计并优化研发管理体系与流程： 灵活运用 Agile、Lean、Scrum、Kanban 及里程碑管理等方法，根据团队所处的研发阶段调整管理方式。与团队管理层合作，建立、推广并持续优化开发流程、项目管理工具（如 Jira）及跨职能协作机制。制定清晰的目标与衡量指标，持续提升流程效率。
  • 组织并推动团队协作机制： 规划和主持团队的核心协作活动，包括项目规划会议、每日站会、任务梳理、里程碑与测试评审，以及回顾总结会议。确保各项会议目标明确、执行高效，并定期评估其实际价值。通过复盘推动交付质量、研发效率及团队健康度的持续改善。
  • 识别并管理项目风险： 在充满不确定性的研发环境中，主动识别潜在障碍、跨团队依赖关系，以及范围、进度和技术方面的风险。及时推动问题解决，必要时提出明确的应对方案并升级处理。制定备选计划、风险情景及调整节点，通过低成本、快速验证的方式帮助团队积累经验、减少无效投入。
  • 建立并维护项目文档及知识管理体系： 建立团队统一、可靠的信息与知识管理机制，包括项目路线图、决策记录、流程规范、里程碑报告及新成员入职资料。针对不同受众提供清晰、简洁的项目沟通与进展汇报。系统性沉淀各阶段经验，确保相关知识能够随着团队及项目的发展持续得到复用。

任职要求（Required Qualifications）

  • 拥有 5 年及以上游戏开发相关工作经验，其中包括在设计、美术、工程等跨职能团队中承担制作管理、项目管理或项目群管理工作的丰富经验。
  • 具备研发探索或新游戏项目开发经验，曾参与游戏项目开发及相关内容制作，并能够适应项目范围和方向的频繁变化。
  • 具有制定和维护中长期项目路线图及执行计划的成功经验，能够协调多个专业领域，并按照预期质量标准可靠地推进交付。

jobs.title: Sound Designer – Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)

  • 负责游戏中音效的设计、制作与实现。

  • 主动根据玩家反馈、测试结果和团队反馈持续迭代。

  • 熟悉 Wwise / FMOD 等音频中间件，并具备实际游戏项目实施经验。
  • 理解游戏引擎中的音频工作方式，具备 Unreal、Unity 或其他商业/自研引擎经验。

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Creative Management - Wild Rift

jobs.title: Treasury and Risk Manager

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played PC game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！
